name: 王明道
objective:
以專題研究方式訓練學生獨立企劃，分析，評斷，歸納及創新思考的能力。並藉由對視覺美學，媒體技術，媒體機能相關性等問題之深入探討，實際演練媒體設計之過程及熟練媒體設計之技巧.
Studio in media design for the senior. Students are expected to exhibit a full range of professional competence and facility in designing advanced media and component complexes of broad scope. All phases of each project design are brought to a professional level under supervision of the director. This course puts emphasis on presentation techniques, including verbal, visual, and written. A project report is required.
schedule:
Introduction to Project Topics, Materials, and Instructor Team; Group Formation
Operation Planning for Interactive Experiences
Operation Simulation for Interactive Experiences
Out-campus Exhibition
Design Proposal Presentation I
Design Proposal Presentation II
Make-up day
[Midterm Evaluation I] Project Proposal Review
Low-Fidelity Prototype Development I
Low-Fidelity Prototype Development II
[Midterm Evaluation II] Low-Fidelity Prototype Review
High-Fidelity Prototype Development I
High-Fidelity Prototype Development II
[Midterm Evaluation III] High-Fidelity Prototype Review
Interactive Prototype Development I
Interactive Prototype Development II
[Final Evaluation] Final Project Prototype Presentation
Review of Final Evaluation
scorePolicy:
[Midterm Evaluation I] Project Proposal – 20%
[Midterm Evaluation II] Low-Fidelity Prototype Development – 10%
[Midterm Evaluation III] High-Fidelity Prototype Development – 20%
[Final Evaluation] Final Project Prototype Presentation – 30%
Class Participation and Engagement – 20%
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
